sources.title: North Island College FY2019/20 employee remuneration and expenses, recovered from archived October 22, 2020 Board agenda
sources.positionDisclosure: not visibly published; white job-title text excluded
notes: Complete five-page published named employee schedule above $75,000; separate Board amounts and below-threshold aggregates are excluded. Missing/dash expenses remain null, explicit zeros would remain zero; no negative amounts occur. Remuneration is the source amount, not base salary or an expense-inclusive total.
Job-title strings embedded as white text are invisible in the published pages and are not used; every exported position is null.
Raw archived bytes are incomplete; the complete employee schedule is recovered by independent MuPDF and Ghostscript PDF repair paths. Original package completeness is not claimed.
Two surviving employee pages and all overall totals agree with the separate signed official SOFI scan dated October 27, 2020. That scan itself omits employee pages 1, 3 and 5.

Archived official minutes of October 22, 2020 record a carried motion approving the Financial Information Act information for the year ended March 31, 2020 (physical/printed page4, item4.2.1); the agenda attachment itself has unsigned approval lines.
sources.publicWarning: The archived official Board package is truncated at 1,048,576 bytes; its archival header reports an original length of 3,739,511 bytes and Warning 299: content truncated by "length". Its complete five-page employee salary schedule has been recovered and independently verified. The currently hosted nine-page SOFI omits salary pages 1, 3 and 5; its two surviving salary pages and overall totals match. Separate official minutes record Board approval on October 22, 2020. A request for a complete original source copy is prepared but unsent. Invisible job-title text is excluded.

validation.independentMethod: MuPDF repair/read of raw archived bytes versus independent Ghostscript repair of five source pages followed by Poppler physical-layout reader. Exact ordered visible name/pay/expense/page equality; hidden white titles excluded.
